mentions.name: Commonplace (LLM wiki)
mentions.description: An LLM wiki (in Karpathy's sense) — a knowledge system with agent-operated memory. It is being used to develop a first-principles theory of what matters in such systems (agent-limited context, statelessness, use goals), with the theory readable online. It also maintains an index of similar agent-memory systems. Work in progress.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on an llm wiki (as defined by Karpathy https://gist.github.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f)

Looks like it is a crowded area now - my angle is to start with theory of what is important in a system like that, from first principles (like agent limited context, statelessness, use goals etc). Currently I use it to develop that theory
